integrity: generation SHA-256 and independent streaming disk SHA-256/size/newline count match for every source; decoded formula checks and repeated content hashes passed on small samples
preservation: Keep sources until ticket-24 complete measurements and concise evidence/hashes are recorded. Ticket-24 implementer owns benchmark integration and cleanup.

units: decimal GB/MB; 1 GB=1,000,000,000 bytes, 125 MB=125,000,000 bytes
